summary.text: Larry Johnson is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia State Senate, District 10, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against Republican Furquan Stafford in a race with no incumbent.
Ballotpedia lists Johnson as winning election to the DeKalb County Commission, District 3, in 2018 and 2022 as the incumbent.

paragraphs.text: Larry Johnson appeared on the ballot for DeKalb County Commission District 3 in the 2018 and 2022 general elections, which Ballotpedia lists him as winning as the incumbent.
He defeated Gabrielle Rogers, 65.2% to 34.8%, in the June 16, 2026 Democratic primary runoff for Georgia State Senate District 10.
